files.description: Primary EHI export documentation (b10). 13-page PDF with data dictionary covering 15 patient data tables (248 fields), export file format specification (ZIP containing CSV + C-CDA XML + PDF files), and export instructions.
Screenshot of the Infinx EHR Certification 5.4 page (viewport), showing the certification details and document links.
Full-page screenshot of the Infinx EHR Certification page showing all sections including the 'Other Information' area with the EHI Export Documentation (b10) link.
Raw HTML of the Infinx EHR Certification page for archival purposes.
Plain text extraction from the EHI Export Documentation PDF via pdftotext. Intermediate artifact used by the enrichment script.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the PDF text extraction into structured JSON. Defines all 15 tables and 248 fields from the data dictionary.

Structured JSON output of the enrichment script. Contains export format specification, instructions, and complete data dictionary with 15 tables and 248 fields including descriptions, data types, and value sets.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
